subject: Indexing
source_sentence: Indexing is the process of describing and identifying a document in terms of its subject content, in order to facilitate the retrieval of information from a collection of documents.
title: TermITH-Eval: a French Standard-Based Resource for Keyphrase Extraction Evaluation

subject: Pattern Matching
source_sentence: The pre-indexing system relies on pattern matching between text and predefined expressions related to potential keyphrases.
title: TermITH-Eval: a French Standard-Based Resource for Keyphrase Extraction Evaluation

subject: Naive Bayes classifier
source_sentence: The two properties (TF-IDF and first position) are used as features of a Naive Bayes classifier that labels either the class of 'keyphrase' or 'non keyphrase' to every textual unit of the document.
title: TermITH-Eval: a French Standard-Based Resource for Keyphrase Extraction Evaluation

subject: Sentence segmentation
source_sentence: We performed sentence segmentation with the PunktSentenceTokenizer provided by the Python Natural Language ToolKit (NLTK), word tokenization using the French tokenizer Bonsai included with the French POS tagger MElt , which we use for POS tagging.
title: TermITH-Eval: a French Standard-Based Resource for Keyphrase Extraction Evaluation
